\ubblockdescription{preprocessing.decompose}{Splits the trace into three layers that add up to it: the slow wander (baseline, a running median), the fast fuzz (noise, a highpass above the cut) and what is left (signal, where the events are). The block page draws all three; `pass\_on` -- or a click on a layer -- chooses the one that goes on down the chain. Tune baseline\_window\_s first: an event longer than about half of it starts going to the baseline, so for drops that recover over 5-10 min use 1800-3600 s. For frequency layers (octaves) use Wavelet bands instead.}

  \ubparam{pass\_\allowbreak{}on}{\texttt{signal}}{one of \texttt{signal}, \texttt{baseline}, \texttt{noise}}{Which layer goes on down the chain: signal (the events, with the slow wander and the fast fuzz taken off), baseline (the slow wander) or noise (the fast fuzz).   \ubparam{baseline\_\allowbreak{}window\_\allowbreak{}s}{600.0}{number, at least 1}{The baseline's running window in seconds. An event longer than about half this window starts going to the baseline; for drops that recover over 5-10 min use 1800-3600 s.   \ubparam{baseline\_\allowbreak{}method}{\texttt{rolling\_median}}{one of \texttt{rolling\_median}, \texttt{rolling\_mean}}{How the baseline is estimated: rolling\_median (a drop or a spike does not pull it) or rolling\_mean (the Detrend block's own estimator).}%
